name: Website Settings-website_button_url
label: Website Button Target
description: Where the Website button in the desk sidebar and the Commons sidebar opens. An absolute URL (https://example.org) or a path on this site (/about). Leave blank to open the site root. This does not change where anyone lands after logging in — that is Home Page above, together with the Home Page on each Role.

name: Role-home_page_priority
label: Home Page Priority
description: Which Home Page wins when someone holds several roles that each name one. Lowest number wins; roles on the same number are settled by name, so the order is always the same on every site and every login. Only meaningful alongside Home Page above. Has no effect unless Enable Home Page Priority is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: Custom DocPerm-require_user_permission
label: Require User Permission
description: A role ticked here sees no records until a User Permission aimed at this doctype narrows it. Has no effect unless Enable Require User Permission Gate is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: DocPerm-require_user_permission
